derivation: feminine of an equivalent perhaps akin to the same as 5514 (from the greenish hue);
def: "gall" or bile, i.e. (by analogy) poison or an anodyne (wormwood, poppy, etc.)

occurrences.text: They gave him vinegar to drink mingled with gall: and when he had tasted thereof, he would not drink.
For I perceive that thou art in the gall of bitterness, and in the bond of iniquity.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
